name: Indian Kirana Shop Owner
description: This persona is a small business owner running a kirana store, general store, dairy booth, or similar neighbourhood retail outlet in India. They are typically owner-operators who handle sales, customer credit, stock management, and daily bookkeeping themselves or with minimal staff support.
painPoints: Limited time to learn complex software
behavior: Already comfortable using WhatsApp in day-to-day business
Prefer low-friction tools that work in Hindi or English without training
value_proposition: DukaanMitra turns familiar WhatsApp messages into structured business records, giving them digital bookkeeping, alerts, reports, and AI-led insights in a format they can adopt quickly.
